email.subject: Re: Bike stand siting, from October 9
email.body:
Anouk Brennagh said on October 9, in the bike repair stand placement discussion: "The public repair stand goes by the river path entrance, not in the car park. The river path is where the flats happen." Sami Okonkwo-Hart said in the same conversation: "Put the pump on a chain; the last one walked off in a week."

So now the stand is set for the river path entrance, where riders are getting their flats, and not for the car park. The pump that goes with it is to be on a chain, because the last one was gone within a week. Nothing in the conversation says the chain is already fitted, so that is still to happen. Neither statement has been reviewed by anyone yet.

My read is that the siting question is settled for this stand, and that the chain is part of what the stand needs rather than an extra. If that holds, nobody has to reopen the car park for this stand unless the flat data starts pointing somewhere else. That suggests to me the chain belongs in the cost of the stand from the start, not added after the first pump walks off.

Does the chain hold for any other pump we place, or only this one? Is the car park still a candidate for a second stand, or is that off the table? And on days the river path is closed, where do riders with flats go?
